snippet.title: Automate It -- Available Now on Steam
snippet.description:
Available now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2472770/Automate_It_Factory_Puzzle

Automate It is a factory-building game where you solve clever challenges under size, power, and time limits. Build and share your own levels, or explore freely in sandbox mode. If you can imagine it, Automate It.

Join our official discord for more news!
http://discord.com/invite/YjTbXnTpct
